sources.locator: ann[16] · Posted on: Monday, October 14, 2024 01:48:38 PM CST
sources.quote:
We have noticed that many midterm exams are arranged on weekends. To avoid conflicts, the CSC1001 Midterm is scheduled for Nov. 1 (Friday) from 19:00 to 21:00.
As a result, tutorials (T13/T14) on Nov. 1 are canceled. If you are in T13/T14, you may attend any tutorial section that week or study independently using the provided slides and codes.
Further details regarding the Midterm arrangements (e.g., locations, permitted materials, etc.) will be communicated in the coming days.
Thanks.

source.locator: ann[15] · Posted on: Thursday, October 17, 2024 07:18:52 PM CST
source.quote:
In response to the numerous concerns raised about the scheduling conflict with the MAT tutorial on Nov. 1, we have made adjustments to the Midterm Time. The midterm will now take place on Nov. 10 (Sunday) from 19:00 to 21:00.
Please note that there will be no make-up for midterm. Since we notice the midterm date about three weeks earlier, it is imperative that all students attend on time. 
Should you encounter any urgent issues preventing your attendance on that day and can provide proof, kindly reach out to me personally.
Additionally, as we rearranged the midterm, the original Tutorial on Nov. 1 will still be held on time.
The details including location and other information will be communicated in the next few days.
Thanks for your understanding.
